LESSON: READING READINESS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Reading readiness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading readiness, part of Reading in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How can we take care of our books?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading readiness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Teamwork as the learner takes part in games that involve turning pages.

• Self-efficacy is developed as the learner turns pages of a book appropriately and carefully while reading pictures.

Values:
• Responsibility: is developed as the learner learns to carefully open pages of a book so as not to tear it.

• Integrity: is developed with the realisation that books should be cared fo

r when reading even when the teacher is not watching.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill self-expression as the learner reads pictures from left to right.

Link to other Learning Areas: All learning areas as the learner reads books from left to right during different lessons.

Suggested learning resources: charts of pictures arranged from the top to the bottom of a page, video clips, and books.
